description: This file defines the SearchFilter interface and its nested enum Type, representing various filter operations for a search query system within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. It specifies filter types like AND, OR, EQ, NE, and comparison operators, as well as their string representations.

classes.name: SearchFilter
classes.description: An interface representing a search filter used in query operations, including methods to get filter type and string representation, annotated as immutable.

classes.name: SearchFilter.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of the different filter types like AND, OR, EQ, NE, GT, LT, etc., each associated with a string name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this filter as a member of the Type enum.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of this filter, defined by its implementation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string name associated with the filter type enumeration.
